faq.title: Questions,
faq.description: The fast read on how Fintela works, what it costs, and where it fits.

assetClasses.q: What asset classes does Fintela support?
assetClasses.a: Currencies, U.S. equities, S&P indices, ETFs, forex, and global markets, all through the same unified strategy engine. Build a strategy once, test it across any cluster you define.

vsBacktesting.q: How is Fintela different from a backtesting library?
vsBacktesting.a: A library runs one backtest. Fintela runs the whole research loop in one place: the universe, the strategy, a search across thousands of parameter combinations, evaluation on held-out data and an overfitting report. Nothing is exported or stitched together between steps.

python.q: Do I need to know Python?
python.a: Not to get started. Strategies are Python functions, and the assistant writes them from a plain-English description for you to review.

optimization.a: Fintela uses intelligent optimization, which learns from each trial to focus search on the most promising parameter regions. Every study is evaluated across three time windows: train (in sample), validation (held out), and out of sample, so robustness is built into the workflow.

seedExport.q: Can I export my strategy's signal?
seedExport.a: Yes. Every trial, basket, and sandbox run exposes its seed: the rebalancing signal (date → ticker → position/allocation) the engine used to build the backtest. You can inspect it date by date and download it as JSON (the exact engine input) or CSV, straight from the app.

liveTrading.a: Validated portfolios can be promoted to live operations that execute through your connected brokerage. You see real time order logs, P&L, and a one click pause. Multiple operations can run in parallel against different baskets.

security.q: Where does my strategy code run?
security.a: You choose. Strategies written in Fintela run in an isolated environment with no access to Fintela’s internal systems, and your data is scoped to your organization. In external mode, your code and data stay on your own servers: Fintela sends parameters and reads back positions.

poweredBy.q: Which AI powers Fintelligent, and what can it do on its own?
poweredBy.a: You choose the AI provider from the options Fintela supports, such as DeepSeek and Anthropic, with no API key to bring. Fintelligent sees only what you can see in your organization. Every tool call is visible, and nothing is saved, launched or spent until you confirm.

speed.q: How fast can I go from idea to live capital?
speed.a: How long it takes depends on your idea and how much you optimize, not on setting up infrastructure. There is no environment to build, no data pipeline to wire up, and no handoff between tools.

overfitting.q: How does Fintela help with overfitting?
overfitting.a: Every study splits its data into train, validation and out-of-sample periods. The search only sees the training period, and the out-of-sample period is held back until the end. When a study finishes, each candidate gets a verdict based on deflated Sharpe, the probability of backtest overfitting and how much performance drops out of sample. This helps identify potential overfitting. It does not predict live results.

thoughts.criteria: Pre-registering before the search: out-of-sample Sharpe above the equal-weight universe's 0.71, PBO under 0.30, deflated Sharpe above 0.95.

science.body: Every trial is on record, the search never sees held-out data, and every result is judged with science-backed methodologies.

cloud.title: One cloud platform
cloud.body: Fintela runs entirely in the cloud. Your data, trials, strategies and results are stored there, ready from any device with nothing to install or maintain.

closing.title: Start with one strategy.
closing.body: Build it, optimize it and see how it performs on data it has never seen. You decide what goes live.

visuals.prompt: Each month, hold the US sectors with the strongest recent returns.
visuals.review: Sent for your review. You decide what goes live.

build.name: Build
build.body: Describe a hypothesis or write it yourself. AI drafts the code and parameters, and you review them.

optimize.name: Optimize
optimize.body: Fintela runs thousands of variations in parallel and records every trial.
optimize.proof: Seven search algorithms, Bayesian by default.

validate.name: Validate
validate.body: Every candidate is tested on data held out from optimization, with statistical tests and plots that show how much of the result may be overfitting.
validate.proof: Deflated Sharpe, overfitting probability, bootstrap confidence intervals.

deploy.name: Deploy
deploy.body: Send the validated strategy to a connected broker and follow it live, from one place.
deploy.proof: Paper or live, with the same code you validated.

build.label: Illustration: a one-line hypothesis and the Python function drafted from it, with its two searchable parameters, lookback and top_n, marked.

optimize.label: Illustration: the equity curves of the trials in one study, fanning out from a common start, beside a count of 1,000 trials.

chart.best: Equity curve of the best in-sample trial: it rises steeply through the training period, flattens in validation and falls once the out-of-sample period starts.
chart.robust: Equity curve of the robust candidate: it rises less steeply than the best in-sample trial and keeps rising after the out-of-sample period starts.

ai.title: Two ways to work with AI

fintelligent.label: Built in
fintelligent.name: Fintelligent
fintelligent.body: The assistant inside Fintela. It drafts strategies, sets up studies and explains results. Nothing is saved or launched until you confirm.
fintelligent.where: Runs inside Fintela, managed for you, with the AI provider you choose.

mcp.label: Bring your own agent
mcp.name: Fintela MCP
mcp.body: Connect Claude Code or claude.ai. Your agent reads overfitting verdicts, checks your strategy server and proposes studies. A person approves every run.
mcp.where: Your strategy code stays on your servers.

funds.title: Hedge funds
funds.body: Research at fund scale without building the infrastructure.

teams.title: Quant teams
teams.body: One shared library of strategies, universes and results for the whole desk.

independents.title: Independent quants
independents.body: Optimize and backtest without maintaining any infrastructure.

advisors.title: Financial advisors
advisors.body: Turn a client mandate into a backtested strategy with a report you can share.
